records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the fourth quarter ended December 31, 2024, revenue was $2.31 billion, a decrease of 1 percent compared to the fourth quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: NOV generated revenue of $8.87 billion in 2024, due to improving quality of our capital equipment backlog, market share gains from new, higher margin technologies and services, and operational efficiencies that more than offset the effect of lower drilling activity.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decline in revenue was due primarily to the divestiture of the Company’s Pole Products business in early 2024 and lower revenue from aftermarket support; however, this was mostly offset by higher revenue from the segment’s growing backlog.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The average price per barrel of West Texas Intermediate Crude was $76.55 in 2024, a decrease of 1% over the average price for 2023 of $77.64 per barrel.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating profit increased 35 percent to $876 million, or 9.9 percent of sales for the full-year 2024.
